name: musicrate
description: MUSICRATE — a closed music platform for artists and listeners. Premium mobile-first UX, real audio uploads, public 0–90 ratings.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.pages:check: npm run pages:build && git diff --exit-code -- docs index.html 404.html .nojekyll
